content: तर, तरण, तरणि, तरण्ड, तरि-री, तरीष <ab>&c.</ab>¦ See under तॄ.

तरणि {%a.%} [तॄ-अनि] <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Passing through, pervading (as the sun). .²2 Quick, energetic, unremitting; विपश्चितं तरणिं भ्राजमानम् <ls>Av. 13. 2. 4</ls>. .²3 Saving, carrying over, benevolent. .{@-णिः@} .²1 The sun; ‘तरणिर्द्युमणौ पुंसि कुमारीनौकयोः स्त्रियाम्’ <ls>Med.</ls> .²2 A ray of light. .²3 The {%Arka%} plant. .²4 Copper. .{@-णिः, -णी@} {%f.%} A raft, boat.
